title: Meeting Rooms II / Sweep Line
contract: Return peak concurrent meetings for half-open intervals [start,end), with start < end. An end at t frees a room before a start at t.
brute: int best=0;for(int[] event:intervals){int active=0;for(int[] x:intervals)if(x[0]<=event[0]&&event[0]<x[1])active++;best=Math.max(best,active);emit("Count active meetings at each start","time",event[0],"active",active,"best",best);}return best;
optimal: List<int[]> events=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] x:intervals){events.add(new int[]{x[0],1});events.add(new int[]{x[1],-1});}events.sort(Comparator.<int[]>comparingInt(x->x[0]).thenComparingInt(x->x[1]));int active=0,best=0;for(int[] x:events){active+=x[1];best=Math.max(best,active);emit("Process end events before starts at equal time","event",x,"active",active,"best",best);}return best;
reasoning: Concurrency can increase only at a start, so scan all intervals at every start.
Convert each interval into a +1 start and −1 end event, sort, and accumulate active meetings.
Tie order matters: ends precede starts under half-open semantics. The largest active count is both a lower bound and sufficient number of rooms.
